summary: Five-phase plan targeting the research-established root cause: general-implementation-agent.md Stage 6's inline summary skeleton, which has never matched summary-format.md and wins over both standing advisory checks. Also aligns summary-format.md's own Example Skeleton with its required-field list, repairs validate-artifact.sh's --fix anchor/sed crash, and adds the missing Stage-6a postflight validation to skill-implementer-hard. Enforcement posture decided explicitly: non-blocking, no auto-repair for summaries, with a compliant run producing zero warnings.
decisions_made: Item C: keep summary validation non-blocking and drop --fix from both implementer summary call sites, since a TBD placeholder makes a non-compliant artifact look compliant while conveying nothing to the human reader; no downstream machine consumer parses the header fields, so the harm does not meet this repo's bar for a blocking gate

validate-artifact.sh --fix anchor bug is IN scope (declared widening beyond file_scope) because the item C signal is delivered through that validator and it can abort before printing its own diagnostic
Hard-mode postflight-validation asymmetry is IN scope: skill-implementer-hard gets a new Stage 6a mirroring the base skill

general-implementation-hard-agent.md expected UNCHANGED - its Stage 6 inherits by 'Same as base agent'; duplicating the skeleton is explicitly forbidden, with a Scope Hypothesis to confirm at implementation time
Research's context/patterns/advisory-signal-desensitization.md recommendation is explicitly OUT of scope, recorded as a visible non-goal rather than silently dropped
Item D honored: no backfill of historical summaries; the resulting residual (whole-directory sweeps can still warn) is stated as an accepted consequence, not hidden
No redeploy step: all edits target agent-system/extensions/**; Phase 5 verifies against the source-store validator and states that this is not a live end-to-end dispatch
